_note: Shell JS/CSS gzip budget in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle.ts after vite build. This is a ratchet: lower the numbers when the shell shrinks, and raise them only for a deliberate, reviewed increase. After an intentional change, run `bun run build` and copy the printed totals here; the budgets are the measured totals plus ~10-15% headroom, with floors of 160000 JS and 26000 CSS.
